CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2838 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d. Bus nonce: 609e158126eec3f759d262fc2e8fcab7. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d` or `Fix review: blocked e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 609e158126eec3f759d262fc2e8fcab7`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2838 e9ac63c18510614713f6fc0329c5c24593d2179d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2838-609e1581`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

ROSTER CARRIES FOR R10-FLOW-JIDOKA (21, from the live roster):

CARRY 2: Self-test hygiene: (a) a new seat-selftest mutant in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py takes a per-file id (for example cloud_relay-1), never a new S number (the P6 convention), and sits inside the block of the instrument it tests, never appended at the file's end, so parallel additions touch different hunks; on 2026-10-21 three pull requests (R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, R10-CI-LAYOUT's PR G) each lost a code round to a content conflict there when main gained tick_loop mutants S31-S34. CARRY 3: Revision 12, moved in revision 15: the orchestrator-added carry disposition ('Carry: dismissed: <reason>' or 'Carry: <group>', under the orchestrator identity, keyed to the verdict's head SHA, read back) is fly-in R10-FLY-CARRY-DISPOSITION, dispatched ahead of the finish-first list; this group keeps its prepr and roster-ref scope.
CARRY 4: Triage P3 (s4): add the base-pinned replay to prepr. CI's policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script restore the checkers from the base (governance.yml 'Restore the check source from the base commit', decision 0013) and grade the pull request's tree with them; prepr 3e-3g runs the head's copy of the same graders and never the base's, so a PR that edits a checker or adds a pinned file passes locally and reddens in CI (#2609 round 2, ~1 h; #2529 policy-docs 'pinned tools/policy/agreement_restore.py is unregistered'). When PIN_TOUCHED=0, build a detached worktree at HEAD, overlay `pinned_paths .github/workflows/*.yml` from origin/main, and run policy_lint.mjs and the agreement and wave-script lanes there; print one `base-pinned replay` step line with the first refusal. Control: a fixture PR that adds a pinned file the base registry lacks must refuse locally; null control: a diff touching no pinned path skips the step with its reason; mutants: removing the overlay makes the fixture pass (the defect), and flipping the gate runs the step on an unpinned diff. Do not extend to jobs that run the head's copy (briefs already runs the head's).
CARRY 5: Orchestrator 2026-10-22 21:39Z, another prepr-passes/CI-fails instance: #2625 (R10-RCA-BODY-LINT) head 10a490f9 went red in CI instrument-self-tests (job 120096849712) on `ref_privacy --check` refusing an unregistered push site added to tools/pr/prepr.sh. open_pr's prepr had passed the head. This is the third such instance on 2026-10-22, after #2622's wave-script agreement lane and r10-rca-body-lint's agreement lane. JIDOKA's prepr replay of the CI lanes must include instrument-self-tests' ref_privacy --check, or prepr must run it directly.
CARRY 6: Owner ruling (tvofi, 2026-10-22, verbatim): "Make sure the JIDOKA group does not add the full ci suite to prepr, only quick checks. Otherwise it sort of defeats the purpose". Binding scope for this group's prepr replay of CI lanes: only quick, deterministic checks, the class that caught 2026-10-22's three prepr-passes/CI-fails instances. That means the base-copy (pinned) graders (agreement lane, check-wave-script, policy-docs), ref_privacy --check and tmp_paths --check, measured at seconds each. No test suite, no entities/features/mutation run, and nothing CI's heavy lanes own. The PR body states each added check's measured wall time and the total added to prepr, and refuses any addition over a budget it names.
